Crops are a source of food and other materials. While each crop is slightly different, crops all have some similar principles. In order to start growing crops, you will need some $(thing)Seeds$(), which can be obtained by searching for $(l:the_world/wild_crops#wild_crops)Wild Crops$() and breaking them.$(br2)Once you have obtained seeds, you will also need a $(thing)Hoe$() to cultivate farmland.

In addition to finding wild crops, seeds can also be produced from existing crops. When a fully mature crop dies―Either by weather, or leaving it to rot―It will go to seed, dropping more seeds that can be used to grow even more crops next season.

pages.title: Дикі рослини
pages.text: $(thing)Wild Crops$() can be found scattered around the world, growing in small patches. They can be harvested for some $(thing)Products$() and $(thing)Seeds$(), which can then be cultivated themselves.$(br2)Wild crops are only mature from June to October. Otherwise, they appear dead until the next Summer.

Wild crops will spawn in climates near where the crop itself can be cultivated, so if you are looking for a specific crop, look in the climate where the crop can be cultivated.$(br2)However, unlike $(l:agriculture/growing_crops)Crops$() that the player has planted, wild crops do not require $(l:agriculture/growing_crops#hydration)Hydration$(). Instead, they are found in areas depending on the average $(l:the_world/climate#temperature)Temperature$() and $(l:the_world/climate#rainfall)Rainfall$().
